errors.evidence: The sectors are not ordered strictly by size. The purple sector (20%) is larger than the blue sector (10%), but the orange sector (24%) is larger than the purple sector (20%), and the green sector (25%) is the largest. The machine-generated description incorrectly states the order as green, orange, purple, blue, red, while the actual order by size is green (25%), orange (24%), purple (20%), blue (10%), red (8%).

The reference description mentions that percentages are written inside the sectors, while the machine-generated description explicitly denies the presence of percentage labels ('диаграмата не съдържа етикети с проценти'), which contradicts the figure.
The machine-generated description does not explicitly state the purpose of the chart (to show the degree of agreement with the statement about design integration), unlike the reference description.
